statement: Sector 7’s record lists it as open but imposes a flight ban today from 12:00–23:00; because the sector is closed under today’s ban, I cannot commit job SV-19 there.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer flags the contradiction—"lists it as open but imposes a flight ban"—and concludes the sector is closed so it "cannot commit job SV-19 there."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
